reserves.name: USDC routed through Venus lending markets (via soul-bound sUSDC)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Circle Internet Financial, Inc. and SoulPeg Venus strategy

sources.label: BSC PublicNode RPC observation at block 123149651 on 2026-09-21

reserveReview.rationale: SoulPeg's current SPUSD documentation states that every SPUSD is backed by sUSDC held in the immutable wrapper and that deposited USDC is routed through StrategyRouter and VenusUSDCVault solely into Venus Protocol's USDC lending market. At BSC block 123149651 on 2026-09-21, SPUSD totalSupply was 33,902,686.433321623719581073 and the wrapper held 49,299,263.792618845501586244 sUSDC, independently confirming full coverage at the wrapper layer. The reviewed reserve remains one 100% tracked USDC exposure routed through Venus; no additional reserve asset or strategy is disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: SoulPeg SPUSD and contract-design disclosures, corroborated by an on-chain SPUSD supply and wrapper sUSDC balance observation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole tracked USDC dependency and Venus lending route are identified; current Venus liquidity and the protocol's operational ability to redirect strategies remain dynamic.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: SoulPeg identifies on-chain strategy and Venus contracts but does not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation treatment for deposited USDC.
